data.summary: Business Analyst and Product Owner with 10+ years of overall IT experience, including 6+ years as a Business Analyst and Product Owner delivering solutions across Capital Markets, Investment Banking, Wealth Management, and Banking Technology platforms. Strong blend of Business Analysis and Product Ownership experience with expertise in Trade Lifecycle Management, Structured Products, Equities, FX Trading, Securities Processing, Corporate Actions, and T24 STP processing. Delivered 6+ end- to-end implementation and transformation projects, working with cross-functional Agile teams across Business, Operations, Product, Compliance, and Technology functions. Experienced in Product Backlog Management, Requirement Elicitation, Stakeholder Management, Sprint Planning, UAT Governance, SQL Data Analysis, API Integrations, and Go-Live Support. Proven track record of improving operational efficiency through workflow automation, process optimization, and digital transformation initiatives while delivering scalable business solutions for global banking clients.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE Business Analyst | Product Owner FinIQConsulting Pvt. Ltd. | Jan 2020 - Dec 2025
Managed and prioritized product backlogs containing 100+ user stories across multiple releases, ensuring alignment with business objectives and delivery timelines.
Collaborated with Product Managers, Business Stakeholders, Operations Teams, and Technology Teams to define product vision, roadmap, feature prioritization, and delivery objectives.
Delivered 6+ implementation and transformation projects across Structured Products, Equities, FX Trading, Securities Processing, and Trade Lifecycle Management platforms.
Led requirement gathering workshops, stakeholder interviews, brainstorming sessions, and process walkthroughs to define solution scope and business requirements.
Facilitated Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Stakeholder Demonstrations.
Created BRDs, FRDs, Functional Specifications, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Process Flows, Data Mapping Documents, and Release Documentation.
Conducted AS-IS / TO-BE analysis, impact assessment, and gap analysis supporting digital transformation initiatives.
Worked closely with Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Operations, Compliance, and Technology teams to ensure successful project delivery.
• Managed UAT planning, execution, stakeholder sign-offs, Go-Live activities, and post-production support. • Performed SQL-based data analysis and API analysis using Postman and Swagger to validate business rules, trade
workflows, and integration requirements.
T24 & STP Enhancements
Led business analysis activities for T24 STP enhancements supporting global banking clients. • Defined business rules, transformation logic, and trade data mapping between upstream trading platforms and downstream settlement systems. • Improved settlement automation and reduced manual intervention across trade lifecycle workflows. • Supported end-to-end validation of trade capture, enrichment, settlement, reconciliation, and reporting
processes.
Business Analyst | Application Consultant FinIQConsulting Pvt. Ltd. | Jan 2017 - Dec 2019
Gathered, analyzed, and documented business and functional requirements for Capital Markets, Wealth Management, and Structured Products platforms.
Prepared BRDs, FRDs, Functional Specifications, Use Cases, Process Flows, Data Mapping Documents, and RTMs. • Performed impact analysis, feasibility assessments, and solution evaluations supporting strategic business initiatives. • Supported API integrations, trade processing workflows, settlement automation, and securities processing enhancements.
Coordinated UAT activities and facilitated business sign-offs for successful project deployments. • Served as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, product teams, development teams, and QA teams throughout the SDLC.
Contributed to successful delivery of multiple client implementations across Structured Notes, Equities Trading, FX Trading, and Securities Processing platforms.
Quality Analyst FinIQConsulting Pvt. Ltd. | Jun 2015 - Dec 2016
Executed regression, smoke, functional, and end-to-end testing for Capital Markets applications. • Performed SQL-based backend validation to ensure data accuracy and settlement flow consistency. • Conducted API and manual testing activities across multiple releases. • Collaborated with Business Analysts, Developers, and Product Teams to validate requirements and improve release quality.
raw_sections.projects:
KEY PROJECTS
EQ-Connect SN – Standard Chartered Bank: Led business analysis activities for EQ Connect v4.7 upgrades and T24 STP enhancements. Defined business rules, trade data mapping, workflow specifications, and settlement automation requirements.
Pictet: Gathered and analyzed requirements for API-driven equities order placement and execution workflows. Defined business rules supporting trade execution and post-trade processing.
OCBC: Supported requirement analysis, workflow design, exception management, and compliance reporting initiatives.
BOS: Defined end-to-end trade lifecycle workflows supporting FX Spot and Forward trading solutions. • Mashreq Supported Corporate Actions processing involving dividends, bonus issues, rights issues, and mandatory events.
DocGen: Led requirement analysis and implementation of automated term sheet generation capabilities. Reduced manual effort and improved operational efficiency through document automation.
1FinIQ | CADB: Supported functional analysis and requirements gathering for Notes, OTC Products, Bonds, and Insurance workflows.
